chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) known as the Sermon of the Skeletons, and it is one of the noble sermons (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What is the Sermon of the Skeletons (Khutbat al-Ashbah) in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Known as 'Khutbat al-Ashbah' (Sermon of the Skeletons), this sermon is distinguished by its vivid imagery of the human body as a temporary vessel, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the transient nature of worldly life (Zuhd). Compiled by Sharif al-Radi, it serves as a profound theological reflection on creation and mortality, often cited in sermons to encourage spiritual detachment and remembrance of the Hereafter.
